Interactive 3D comparison tool

STL Scale Converter
& 3D Visualizer

Compare miniature scales side-by-side in an interactive 3D environment. Rotate, zoom, and measure against a calibrated 10mm grid. Works with Warhammer 40k, D&D, Bolt Action, Star Wars Legion, and 15+ tabletop scales.
